sections.html: *Indicates Key Condition. This is not an exhaustive list of medical conditions.

nodes.t: Erythematous, poorly demarcated, non-palpable, blanchable rash
Pustules with overlying thick honey-yellow crusts. Occurs in clusters
Erythematous sand-paper like rash over trunk, extremities, cheeks …
nodes.d: Erythematous sand-paper like rash over trunk, extremities, cheeks. Strawberry tongue. Spares palms and soles. Pastia lines

nodes.t: Widespread erythroderma involving face, diaper, intertriginous areas …
nodes.d: Widespread erythroderma, involving the face, diaper, and intertriginous areas. Desquamation and crusting present. Nikolsky sign.

nodes.t: Purpuric, non blanchable rash over full body
Erythematous, blanchable macules spreading cephalo-caudally. Koplik spots …
nodes.d: Erythematous, blanchable macules spreading cephalo-caudally. Koplik spots. URTI symptoms and pharyngitis

nodes.t: Bright red, well demarcated rash over cheeks – “slapped-cheek” appearance …
nodes.d: Bright red, well demarcated rash over cheeks – “slapped-cheek” appearance. May have lacy reticular rash over hands and feet
Erythematous, blanchable macules spreading cephalo-caudally. Rash usually starts after fever defervesces

nodes.t: Flesh colored, well demarcated papules with umbilicated center
Vesicular rash filled with clear fluid, on an erythematous base …
nodes.d: Vesicular rash filled with clear fluid, on an erythematous base. Highly pruritic

nodes.t: Erythematous papules and vesicles over hands and skin folds …
nodes.d: Erythematous papules and vesicles distributed over hands and skin folds. Burrow may be present. Highly pruritic.
